mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id, n.notice_title, n.notice_views, n.created_at, n.updated_at, u.user_nickname AS admin_name, CASE WHEN n.is_deleted = 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS active_flag FROM tb_notice n LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON n.admin_id = u.user_id ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_notice WHERE is_deleted = 'N'

SELECT n.notice_title AS noticeTitle, n.notice_content AS noticeContent, n.notice_views AS noticeViews, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.updated_at AS updatedAt, u.user_nickname AS adminName, CASE WHEN n.is_deleted = 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS isActive FROM tb_notice n LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON n.admin_id = u.user_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId}

SELECT n.notice_id, n.notice_title, n.notice_views, n.created_at, n.updated_at, u.user_nickname AS admin_name, CASE WHEN n.is_deleted = 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS active_flag FROM tb_notice n LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON n.admin_id = u.user_id WHERE n.is_deleted = CASE WHEN #{active} = 'Y' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_notice WHERE is_deleted = CASE WHEN #{active} = 'Y' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END
